target.identity_source: Prior authorized lithium installation identity; OPERATIONS.md

ui.counter_scope: cumulative snapshots, never summed; queue intent / read copyout / HID call return / after-CA observer are distinct

temperature.phase_assignment: saved console order between UI state transitions; not exact cross-thread timestamp alignment

framebuffer.scope: band=0 setup; band=1 complete draw job row extent; band=2..9 individual row partitions. Primary statistics use band=1 only; partitions are neither mixed nor summed. CPU and wall are separate; wall includes possible scheduling time; no physical FPS inferred

transport.scope: Saved USB byte stream only. Pre-framing printf truncation and uncollected daemon or firmware output remain outside this audit.

hardware_scope: Normal UFS unmount, final flush/seal, USB drain, and same-device Fastboot observed; firmware-internal Prepare/Commit and power-loss durability not independently traced.
